FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #19 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'oui' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. yes
   B. goodbye
   C. hello, good day
   D. Sir, Mr

2. Which of these is said as sa-LÜ? (1 mark)
   A. bonjour
   B. au revoir
   C. salut
   D. merci

3. What does 'la famille' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the grandfather
   B. the girl
   C. the father
   D. the family

4. What does 'le garçon' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the grandfather
   B. the boy
   C. the child
   D. the grandmother

5. How do you say 'It is a bed.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est un lit.
   B. La télé est dans le salon.
   C. Le livre est sur la table.
   D. Le tapis est devant le canapé.

6. What does 'Où est ... ?' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the sofa
   B. Where is ... ?
   C. the book
   D. the cat

7. How do you say 'On Thursday, I sing.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Quel jour est-ce aujourd'hui ?
   B. Le jeudi, je chante.
   C. Le vendredi, je danse.
   D. Une semaine, sept jours.

8. What does 'jeudi' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Thursday
   B. Friday
   C. Sunday
   D. Tuesday

9. Which month is 'octobre'? (1 mark)
   A. October
   B. February
   C. July
   D. April

10. What number is 'dix' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 11
   C. 31
   D. 10

11. What does 'le poisson' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. fish
   B. juice
   C. the banana
   D. the carrot

12. How do you say 'I do not like fish.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Je n'aime pas le poisson.
   B. C'est une banane.
   C. Qu'est-ce que c'est ?
   D. Je bois un jus.

13. What does 'court' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. long
   B. tall, big
   C. short
   D. black

14. What does 'le nez' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the stomach
   B. the back
   C. the mouth
   D. the nose

15. What does 'le bras' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the ear
   B. the foot
   C. the shoulder
   D. the arm

16. How do you say 'I have ten fingers.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai dix doigts.
   B. Il a les cheveux courts.
   C. Elle a les cheveux noirs.
   D. Il est grand.

17. What does 'la neige' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the snow
   B. the wind
   C. the storm
   D. the weather

18. What does 'le nuage' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the rain
   B. the cloud
   C. a flood
   D. the storm

19. How do you say 'Turn left.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Allez tout droit.
   B. Tournez à gauche.
   C. Où est la clé ?
   D. La télé est sur la table.

20. What does 'à gauche' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to the right
   B. next to
   C. to the left
   D. near

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write a short birthday dialogue of four lines. (4 marks) (4 marks)

22. Write a short dialogue asking what day it is and answering. (3 marks) (3 marks)

23. Explain the difference between C'est un, C'est une and Ce sont des. (4 marks) (4 marks)

24. Write a role play of four lines in which you introduce your family. (4 marks) (4 marks)

25. Give three tips for listening for the gist of a message. (3 marks) (3 marks)

26. Explain why correct pronunciation is important when you speak French. Give one example of a sound that is different from English. (3 marks) (3 marks)

27. Write five parts of the body in French with le, la or les. (5 marks) (5 marks)

28. List four things you find at a birthday party in French with un or une. (4 marks) (4 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #19 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — yes
   oui means yes.

2. C — salut
   Salut is said sa-LÜ and the final t is silent.

3. D — the family
   la famille means the family.

4. B — the boy
   le garçon means the boy.

5. A — C'est un lit.
   It is a bed. in French is C'est un lit.

6. B — Where is ... ?
   Où est ... ? means Where is ... ?.

7. B — Le jeudi, je chante.
   On Thursday, I sing. in French is Le jeudi, je chante.

8. A — Thursday
   jeudi means Thursday.

9. A — October
   octobre means October.

10. D — 10
   dix means 10.

11. A — fish
   le poisson means fish.

12. A — Je n'aime pas le poisson.
   I do not like fish. in French is Je n'aime pas le poisson.

13. C — short
   court means short.

14. D — the nose
   le nez means the nose.

15. D — the arm
   le bras means the arm.

16. A — J'ai dix doigts.
   I have ten fingers. in French is J'ai dix doigts.

17. A — the snow
   la neige means the snow.

18. B — the cloud
   le nuage means the cloud.

19. B — Tournez à gauche.
   Turn left. in French is Tournez à gauche.

20. C — to the left
   à gauche means to the left.

SECTION B
----
21. (4 marks)
   Answer: Bon anniversaire ! Merci ! Tu as quel âge ? J'ai dix ans.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct line.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: Quel jour est-ce aujourd'hui ? Aujourd'hui, c'est mardi.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the question, 1 mark for aujourd'hui and 1 mark for a correct day.

23. (4 marks)
   Answer: C'est un is for one masculine thing, C'est une is for one feminine thing, and Ce sont des is for many things.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each pattern and 1 mark for an example.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: Bonjour ! Voici ma famille. C'est ma mère. C'est mon père.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for greeting, 1 mark for voici, 1 mark for each correct C'est line.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: Listen for words you know; listen for the topic first; do not translate every word; listen again for details.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each tip.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: Correct pronunciation helps people understand you and shows respect for the language. For example, the letter j says zh, as in bonjour.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for understanding, 1 mark for respect or communication, 1 mark for a correct example.

27. (5 marks)
   Answer: la tête, les yeux, le nez, la bouche, la main
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its article.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: un gâteau, une bougie, un cadeau, un ballon
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its un or une.
